Co-written adapts the 26-pattern catalogue for editorial review. It does not run the rewrite workflow or claim authorship detection. The original source and licence are preserved here. The bundled catalogue summarises its guidance; local rules implement a conservative subset. Context-sensitive patterns are assessed by the optional AI review. Neither path is a validated detector.
